source:
Rae: The onboarding beta is healthy enough to expand. Yesterday's export says:
```json
{"invited":50,"active":41,"crashes":2,"median_minutes":6}
```
Forty-one active users is enough to ship the onboarding test to the next cohort.
Dev: That JSON proves my point. Two crashes among 41 active users is too high to expand it, especially when the first screen is where people decide whether the product feels reliable.
Rae: Two crashes is not a launch blocker for a beta.
Dev: It is a blocker when the beta is supposed to test first impressions.
